description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
When Mishra's Bauble enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Mishra's Bauble.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Mishra's Bauble ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
